status: draft: roles and constants carried from ALC (AlaCarteShaders 0.5, MC 1.21.11); positions are chosen in the new 26.3 world (M2); every [verify] item is re-measured on the platform

display.why: bench resolution = play resolution (user, 2026-10-05); keeps every variant GPU-bound (ALC: GPUBusy/FrameTime 0.995-1.005 on 108/108 captures)
display.windowKeys: fullscreen:true, exclusiveFullscreen:false (vanilla borderless); Sodium flips exclusiveFullscreen to true once on a fresh sodium-options.json (notifications.has_edited_fullscreen_option), so the harness writes that file first (spike L1, L2)
display.optionsTxtWhy: the keys the spike wrote before L1 and read back after the first quit; the game kept every value except two: Sodium forced exclusiveFullscreen true on its first run and the fancy preset forced simulationDistance 12 (recorded here as 12 and kept as the identity value: user, 2026-10-06). version:5023 keeps the schema-4892 datafixer from resetting preferredGraphicsBackend; graphicsPreset custom keeps Minecraft's constructor from applying a preset over renderDistance, simulationDistance, mipmapLevels, biomeBlendRadius and more; maxFps 260 is the slider's unlimited value (L1 ran 141 fps); fov is stored as (degrees - 70) / 40; the game drops the 'fabric' pack id from resourcePacks; no rawMouseInput: 26.3 removed that option (input runs through SDL3's relative mouse mode) and drops the line at its next save, so the mod's input.block alone covers raw motion (lessons.md#windows; user, 2026-10-06)
display.sodiumOptionsWhy: sha256 of sodium-options.json as launch writes it before every launch: sodiumOptionsFile in Sodium 0.9.2's own format (two-space indent, LF, no final newline), the file Sodium itself wrote in the spike's L2 (the spike set none of its keys), with notifications.has_edited_fullscreen_option true (else Sodium sets exclusiveFullscreen on a fresh file) and performance.use_no_error_g_l_context false (else the dev tier's debug context opens a modal Iris dialog); one file for every tier, so one hash; launch refuses a file that no longer hashes to it. Every key in this block is identity (run-record.md#identity)
display.irisPropertiesWhy: launch writes config/iris.properties fresh before every launch: shaderPack (the reference pack until run builds variants), then these keys and the tier's from irisTiers; enableDebugOptions only on dev (the KHR_debug context per-pass timers need, platform.md#mod-tiers); disableUpdateMessage keeps Iris off the network; maxShadowRenderDistance 32 as the spike ran; Iris adds its other keys at their defaults when it rewrites the file (spike R4)

coverageViews.area: frozen, out of sight of every perf view
content: held torch (creative mode; spectator shows no hand)
coverageViews.rule: every program on the shader coverage list is drawn by >= 1 coverage view; anything still moving under /tick freeze is excluded from identical/near checks

motionPathsWhy: draft v0: movement in 2 overworld + 1 nether scene; ALC pans were a triangle-wave yaw sway, one sway per window, rotation only; params set in M5 from that

quick.why: one view per dimension; estimate from ALC 4.4 s/capture

full.why: ALC calibrated R=2; ALC's ~15 min for 8 views scaled to 10 views (estimate)

capture.why: ALC calibrated: 1.5 s checked over 372 reloads; Nether still meshing at 2 s (12.7 % drift); underwater 6.2 % of pixels differ at 0.5 s; reload cap from ALC's Iris reload leak (10.4 MB/reload on 1.10.7); the spike measured 20.6 MiB heap and 320 MiB private bytes per reload on the dev tier with debug options (platform.md#mc-263-verified), so M1 re-measures on the bench tier before the cap is trusted; ticksAfterWeatherChange from ALC's /tick step 120 (weather ramps only while ticking) [verify on the platform]; maxPendingFrames bounds the mod's pending frame readbacks (~530 MB at 4K, mod.md#8-capture)
capture.unitsWhy: seconds, timed by the mod on the QPC clock (ALC calibrated settles and windows in seconds; a frame-count wait was rejected)

validity.tailWhy: tail = median of per-capture p95 frame times (measurement.md#session); ALC: p99 swung up to 39.5 % between identical captures; per-capture p95s live in the committed record, so the tail can be re-judged

cpuFloorMs.status: measured in M2 per view with a passthrough pack
cpuFloorMs.why: ALC: the lightest captures (TAA, storm or clouds off) were still GPU-bound, so the floor is at most these frame times; below 0.9x the floor the 90 % rule fails and cost rows need per-pass timers

validity.queueSignalWhy: GPULatency well under one frame = CPU-limited; ALC saw ~2.7 frames in all 2,124 captures. PresentMon 2.x: GPULatency = time from the frame's CPU start until the GPU started working on it (README-ConsoleApplication.md, v2.6.0)

statistics.schedule: A, then (Ci, A) pairs, R rounds; A/A twin is always one Ci
statistics.why: ALC: bracketing beat ABBA (rms 0.52 -> 0.33 %) against 10-40 s GPU regimes; one geo-mean test per candidate; the thresholds are empirical and target <= 5 % false accepts, monitored by every session's twin

twinMonitor.why: more than 2 of the last 20 twins over the geo-mean threshold forces recalibration (7.5 % odds by chance at 5 %); the window restarts at each calibration

statistics.deltaUnitWhy: delta = 100 x (ratio - 1), in %, negative = faster; thresholds on |delta| of the null candidates (measurement.md#verdicts-and-cost-rows)

flip.why: 32-inch 16:9 4K panel viewed from about 70 cm (user, 2026-10-06; design.md D5)

profiles.iso: config/profiles/complementary-unbound-iso.json: dropped features off; kept features matched to Optilux as they land
